# Motion Celebrate

Full-screen celebration fired on page load or from a Dynamic Action: confetti cannons, a confetti rain or fireworks, optionally with the native APEX success message.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_MOTION_CELEBRATE` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/motionCelebrate` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |

Place the region anywhere (use a blank region template; it renders nothing visible). Trigger On Page Load for success pages, or On Event and fire it from a Dynamic Action with apex.event.trigger(document, 'amc-celebrate') or amcCelebrate.fire(). Users with reduced motion get only the message.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | Effect | selectList (`cannons`, `rain`, `fireworks`) | yes | `cannons` | The celebration. |
| `trigger` | Trigger | selectList (`load`, `event`) | yes | `load` | On Page Load fires once when the page opens. On Event waits for the amc-celebrate event. |
| `message` | Success Message | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional text shown with the native APEX success message, for example Order placed. |
| `intensity` | Intensity | selectList (`subtle`, `big`) |  |  | How much confetti or how many rockets. Leave empty for normal. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/motion-celebrate/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_motion_celebrate.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
